name: Choco Kiss Cookies
ingredients:
Choco Cream (36%) [Sugar, Vegetable Fat, Cocoa Solids, Emulsifiers (E322 from Soya)], Refined Wheat Flour (Maida), Sugar, Edible Vegetable Oil (Palm), Milk Solids, Golden Syrup, Cocoa Powder, Emulsifier (E322 from Soya), Leavening Agents (E503 ii, E500 ii), Salt. CONTAINS ADDED ARTIFICIAL FLAVOUR (VANILLIN). 
Allergen Advice: Contains Gluten, Milk and Soya. May contain traces of Nuts.
